runtime_patches: layernorm_gated.py (native-torch RMSNormGated): add the sigmoid gate, rmsnorm(x)*sigmoid(z), used by the Qwen3.8 Gated-DeltaNet output norm (TPU fallback only implemented SiLU)

qwen4_exp.py PLE (per-layer n-gram embedding, layer 2) made TorchTPU-traceable (block appended from q38_qwen4_exp_tpu_ple.py): _PLEBatch msgspec.Struct -> NamedTuple (Dynamo cannot construct msgspec Structs); padded static shapes (no slicing by host real-token counts -> no per-prompt-length recompiles); flat token-major EXTEND layout for n-gram windows / short-conv taps / state commit; fresh requests (extend_prefix_lens==0) start from zero short-conv state + EOS n-gram history in-graph (TpuMambaPool.clear_slots never resets the PLE side-state pools -> cross-request state leak otherwise); int32-only integer math with an exact base-2^12-limb evaluation of the int64 n-gram hash (the TPU XLA backend aborts on the s64 multiply/xor/remainder/cumsum), hash constants checked against the loaded buffers; no CUDA/Triton fused kernels, no cummax/cumsum. Same math: CPU-verified bit-exact vs upstream (extend with padding/chunk continuation/EOS, decode with padded rows, MTP verify, 200k-window hash sweep)
ple_state_pool.py NGramPool: int32 instead of int64 storage/indices (token ids < 2^31) so the TPU graph carries no s64 PLE state

modelopt_quant.py: TpuModelOptNvFp4FusedMoEMethod.use_flashinfer_trtllm_weight_layout = False (the TPU subclass skips the parent __init__ that sets it; FusedMoE.weight_loader raised AttributeError; TPU keeps the canonical w13 layout)
